verdict.rationale: Exa's Search API and Websets accept plain natural-language queries (e.g. 'agtech companies in the US that raised Series A', 'Find engineering leaders at AI infrastructure companies...'), and the MCP server lets AI assistants issue these commands directly, showing genuine natural-language operability. However, hands-on community reports show the natural-language queries frequently miss requested fields or return low accuracy (30/70 hit rate, missing price columns), indicating the feature works but not reliably. Missing for 10: independent benchmarks confirming consistent NL command accuracy, and resolution of the reported accuracy gaps.
